sam (PM): Quick sync: we need to finalize Console Observe launch checklist tomo. Focus areas: dashboards, tracing hooks (sampling + redaction), cost split by model/route, and error analytics. Want clear acceptance gates + owner for each.

jia (Eng): Agree. Main risk: enabling trace hooks increases tail CPU and adds bursty write IO for trace storage. We should define conservative defaults and switchable knobs.

noah (SRE): On staging I saw trace write QPS spike at error storms. Proposal: write buffer + async flush with backpressure to avoid 503s. If backlog > 5k events, downgrade sampling to 0.1% automatically.

sam (PM): Owners and proposed gates (need sign-off):
- Dashboards (owner: maya): show errors by model, route, customer, and cost delta tile
- Tracing hooks (owner: jia): honor sampling policy + per-tenant redaction rules
- Cost breakdown (owner: tess): token-level cost by model + route, 24h and rolling-2h views
- Error analytics (owner: noah): grouping by stackframe + one-click trace drilldown

maya (Solutions): Customers ask for per-tenant cost visibility and an "error heatmap" widget. Also request a way to export trace snippets for compliance teams. Need API contract.

tess (Eng-Platform): For cost we can emit a "charge_event" that includes model, route, tokens, and tier. We'll surface a cost tile in the dashboard and a /costs/export endpoint for CSV.

jia (Eng): Sampling policy suggestion: 
- error: 100% capture for requests with status >= 500 or explicit error tag
- success: adaptive sampling based on QPS tier (tiered: <10rps = 5%, <100rps = 1%, >=100rps = 0.1%)
- global cap: 200 traces/min per region
We'll implement as a decision tree in runtime.

noah (SRE): Add circuit-breaker rule: if CPU delta > 15% vs baseline or avg latency increases > 10% over 5m, auto-throttle sampling to baseline 0.1% and page oncall.

sam (PM): Acceptance thresholds to proceed past canary -> 50%:
1) Dashboards: error-by-model & route tile present and updates within 2m
2) Tracing: sampling rules enforced and redaction tests passing for FinCust (account_id/email removed)
3) Perf: p95 API latency <= 620ms for console calls
4) Cost: rolling-2h cost delta < 10% vs baseline (measure includes trace write cost + token cost)
5) Operational: trace backlog < 5k and trace storage write latency < 300ms

tess (Eng-Platform): We'll add a gating metric panel with pass/fail for each threshold. Link will be shared in thread during canary.

maya (Solutions): FinCust requirement: traces must not contain raw customer_email or ssn. We'll provide test strings and a verification script. Add explicit approval from customer before 50%.

jia (Eng): Implementation plan: runtime sampling hooks + per-tenant config + redaction sanitizers. I'll add feature flag observe_v2 with rollout steps. ETA for canary PR is EOD.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 11:15 PT -> 10% traffic.

noah (SRE): I'll run a 45m synthetic that exercises error spikes and steady high-QPS to validate auto-throttle behavior. If backlog or CPU deltas exceed thresholds, I will mark gate fail.

sam (PM): Rollout cadence: canary (10%) -> observe 45m -> check gates -> 50% for 2h -> final sweep then 100%. Rollback policy: immediate rollback if any perf or backlog gate fails or customer redaction test fails.

maya (Solutions): Owners confirmed. I'll draft the customer communication template for FinCust and Acme with opt-in toggles and a brief on redaction guarantees.

jia (Eng): I'll post the PR link + runtime logs here when ready. Also adding a smoke test that validates the trace header propagation and redaction.

sam (PM): Great. Please post the dashboard snapshot links and synthetic run logs here during the canary window. If anyone thinks a gate is missing, add now. Otherwise, we'll treat this thread as the canonical launch checklist. :rocket:
